No running today. Injury-prevention session — nothing to failure, nothing that leaves you sore on Saturday.

Conversational the whole way — the cyclist's engine will want to go faster; the legs don't get a vote yet, so don't let it. Finish with 6 × 20–25 s strides, building to about mile pace, relaxed, full walk-back between. They keep leg speed while everything else is slow.  If Tuesday's bike session was big, skip this.

sessions.title: Mobility + leg maintenance
sessions.detail:
No running today. Injury-prevention session — nothing to failure, nothing that leaves you sore on Saturday.

1. Mobility (10'): couch stretch 2×60 s/side · 90/90 hip switches 2×8 · ankle dorsiflexion wall touches 2×10/side · thoracic rotations 2×8/side
2. Strength-light (12'): banded lateral walks 3×12/side · single-leg glute bridge 3×10/side · Copenhagen plank 3×20 s/side
3. Nordic curls 2×4 — the best eccentric hamstring work there is. Sore for the first few weeks; that's why they start now, not in December.
4. Step-downs off a box 2×10/side, slow · single-leg balance
5. Dead bug or Pallof if time

sessions.title: MARATHON
sessions.detail:
Race day.

Seville: 08:30 gun, breakfast 05:30–06:00, gel 15 min before the start. Self-supported: start 09:30–10:00, 4 laps of the Bos loop, bag at the lap point.

PACING: 5:12–5:20/km through 30 km depending on the goal you locked in W15. No faster in the first 10 km, whatever it feels like. Even splits. First-timers who go out 10 s/km fast lose 5+ minutes in the last 10 km.

FUEL: gel at 40 min then every 30 min, 60 g carbs/hour, water at every station.

Goals: A 3:40 (5:12) · B 3:45 (5:19) · C 3:55 (5:34).
